title: Quote: See, one of the things you have to remember is that we start...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: The Bang Behind the Bucks, The Life Behind the Style
content: See, one of the things you have to remember is that we started off with a very idealistic perspective--that doing something with the highest quality, doing it right the first time, would really be cheaper than having to go back and do it again. Ideas like that.
